data.gender_notes: Cemal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word ‘C-M-L’, meaning ‘to last’, ‘to continue’. This name is associated with the eternal and everlasting nature of Allah (swt). The name Cemal carries the meaning “Eternal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Cemal usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the continuity of life and the eternal nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Cemal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cemal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
